author: Zetetic I
title: Simple 1D CNN for Sequence Motif Detection
abstract: This submission replaces the default position-wise MLP with a simple 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The hypothesis is that capturing local sequential patterns (motifs) via convolutions will provide a significant performance improvement over the non-sequential baseline. The architecture consists of a single 1D convolutional layer followed by global average pooling and a final dense layer for prediction.
